join hortbot 999 foobar 1

clock_set 2000-10-01T03:11:00Z

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add repeatme Hello there! (_MESSAGE_COUNT_)
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' added, restricted to subscribers and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!schedule add repeatme 0_*_*_*_* 3
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' has been scheduled with '0 * * * *' and will run if at least 3 messages have passed.

checkpoint
clock_forward 10s
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 1h
sleep 100ms
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 30m
sleep 100ms
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 30m
sleep 100ms
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

sleep 100ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hello there! 5
